newsitem.title: USA: U.S., French investigate oxygen generator shipment.
newsitem.headline: U.S., French investigate oxygen generator shipment.

text.p: U.S. and French officials are investigating whether more than 900 oxygen generators may have been shipped into the United States aboard two Air France flights, the Federal Aviation Administration said Tuesday.

Oxygen generators were implicated in the crash of a ValuJet flight near Miami in May last year that killed 110 people. Generators have been banned from passenger planes since then although they can be carried by cargo planes if properly labelled and declared.

"While the alleged shipment appears to have included generators packed in protective metal containers, we are very concerned that they may have been on board a passenger plane," said Cathal Flynn, associate administrator for Civil Aviation Security at the FAA.
"Every shipper and every airline should know by now these shipments are strictly illegal," Flynn said in a statement.
The FAA said the oxygen generators were undeclared and may have been aboard an all-cargo flight and a combination passenger-cargo flight.
FAA said it began its probe on June 30 when Federal Express notified it of a shipment of undeclared generators within the United States that was traced back to Air France.
